question: Who won the Best Actor in a Leading Role award in the 94th Academy Awards 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Will Smith.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• The winners of the 94th Academy Awards or Oscar awards were announced on 28 March 2022.
 
• Will Smith was declared best actor for 'King Richard.
 
• While Jessica Chastain won the best actress Oscar for “The Eyes of Tammy Faye."
 
• Jane Campion became just the third woman in the 94-year history of the Oscars to win the best director, for her “Power of the Dog.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points:__

 
• "CODA" won all three awards it was nominated for, including Best Picture in Oscar 2022 ceremony.
 
• ​Troy Kotsur, who won for best supporting actor, became the first Deaf man to win an Academy Award for acting. 
 
• Jessica Chastain won her first Oscar for her performance in "The Eyes of Tammy Faye."
